column1: # All 159 phase IDs from the name table at VA 0x22BD0C0 (file off 0x1EBD0C0, rodata delta 0x400000).
# bin_index : phase ID; index into name table 0x22BD0C0 AND the 159-arm factory jump table 0x22BBEB8.
# phase_name : exact plaintext string (no decoding needed).
# name_va    : VA of the name string in .rodata.
# is_default : true for IDs 0..156 (in the default schedule 0x22BEEA0, count 157);
#              false for 157 (DebuggerBreak) and 158 (NOP) -- registered but NOT dispatched
#              by default; reachable only via the recipe/named-phases path (knob 298).
# Factory: sub_C60D30, cmp $0x9e (158) upper bound, jmp *0x22BBEB8(,idx,8); all 159 arms distinct
#          (each phase has its own 16-byte object + vtable). Arm 157 -> 0xc60d61, arm 158 -> 0xc61ae8.
